headline: MIL @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.23 at HOU 2.45, with a projected total of 6.68. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (MIL -0.48, HOU -0.40), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.88, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.7%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Jacob Misiorowski has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for William Contreras, Jeremy Peña, Jackson Chourio, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nick Allen, Braden Shewmake because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
